desktop.account.title: Ku soo gal getcadcraft.com
desktop.account.signed_out.text: Soo galidda waxay app-kan u ogolaanaysaa inuu furo oo kaydiyo naqshadahaaga kaydka cloud-ka. Halkan waxaad heli doontaa koodh gaaban, oo waxaad ansixisaa website-ka, browser-kaaga gaarka ah. Waxba qarsoon lama qoro ama lama koobiyeeyo.
desktop.account.waiting.title: Ansixi koodhkan website-ka
desktop.account.waiting.text: Browser-kaaga ayaa furmay getcadcraft.com/device. Hubi inuu tusayo koodhkan, kadibna ansixi.
desktop.account.waiting.own: Ansixi kaliya koodh halkan lagu tusay, app-kaaga gaarka ah.

desktop.account.waiting.left.=1: Koodhku wuxuu shaqeynayaa 1 daqiiqo oo kale.
desktop.account.waiting.left.one: Koodhku wuxuu shaqeynayaa {n} daqiiqo oo kale.
desktop.account.waiting.left.other: Koodhku wuxuu shaqeynayaa {n} daqiiqo oo kale.

desktop.account.signed_in.title: Waa la soo galay
desktop.account.signed_in.text: Kombiyuutarkan wuxuu ku sii jiri doonaa soo gal ilaa aad ka baxdo halkan, ama aad ka saarto getcadcraft.com hoos Akoon, Amni.
desktop.account.only_desktop: Daaqaddan waxay shaqeysaa kaliya gudaha app-ka desktop-ka CadCraft.
desktop.reason.throttled: Koodho badan waqti gaaban. Isku day mar kale daqiiqado kadib.
desktop.reason.expired: Koodhku wuu dhammaaday ka hor intaan la ansixin. Codso mid cusub.
desktop.reason.denied: Soo galka website-ka ayaa la diiday.
desktop.reason.revoked: Kombiyuutarkan website-ka getcadcraft.com ayaa laga saaray soo galkii. Mar kale soo gal si aad u isticmaasho naqshadahaaga cloud-ka; wax kasta oo kombiyuutarkan ku jiray lama lumin.
desktop.reason.offline_signout: Kombiyuutarkan waa laga saaray soo galkii. Website-ka lama gaari karin: soo galkan waxaa sidoo kale lagu liistay getcadcraft.com/account/security, halkaas oo aad ka saari kartid.
desktop.reason.keystore: Kaydka aqoonsiga kombiyuutarkan ayaa diiday soo galka.
desktop.carry.title: Diyaarinta CadCraft Studio
desktop.carry.text: Waxaa la soo wareejinayaa dejintaadii, faylalkii dhowaa iyo nuqullada soo kabashada ee app-yadii kala go'a ee ka hor la rakibay.
